Maya K: Heads-up: final round for SWE-3 candidate on Thurs 4/10. Panel slots need confirmation — 1.5h block starting 13:00 PT. Can folks confirm availability + debrief owner? Calendar invite here: https://cal.example.com/abc123
Samir Patel: I'm available. Happy to own debrief (take notes + sync). Can someone add rubrics link?
Elena Gomez: I can make the 13:00 PT slot but prefer 13:30 start? I have a client call that overruns sometimes. Also quick rubric Q: scoring rubric shows 'tech depth' 40 pts and 'system design' 30 pts — do we average those or pick dominant? :thinking_face:
Jordan Liu: I can cover interviewer slot 2 if needed. For rubric: we weight sections independently and sum. For borderline, use 'recommendation' field. cc @Samir Patel — will you want a debrief template?
Samir Patel: Yep. Use this template: https://docs.example.com/swe-debrief-template. I'll set the debrief doc owner to 'Samir Patel'. Also suggest adding a 5min buffer after each interviewer for quick notes.
Maya K: Thanks. @Elena Gomez ok to nudge calendar to 13:30? If so I'll update invite. Also please add a 15m pre-brief for the panel at 13:15 to align.
Elena Gomez: 13:30 works for me. 15m pre-brief is helpful. One more rubric ask: performance vs code quality — should the coding task get tie-breaker? I've seen inconsistent use across teams.
Jordan Liu: Good question. Our guideline: code correctness (pass/fail) is a prerequisite; quality/clarity are tiebreakers. I'll paste a short note in the rubric section: `Code correctness required; if candidate fails basic acceptance tests, score lower despite good discussion.`
People Ops Bot: Calendar invite updated by Maya K: new start 13:30 PT, prebrief 13:15 PT. Zoom link: https://zoom.example/meet. Reminder set 30m prior.
Maya K: Great — final checklist: confirm recording permission, confirm interviewer list in invite, Samir to create debrief doc and owner, Jordan to paste rubric note. Ping me if anything else. :thumbsup:
Elena Gomez: Candidate gave recording permission in their intake form. I'll DM if anything changes.
